name: FREIA — France Real Estate Intelligence Agent
description: FREIA is a France-focused real-estate intelligence agent providing structured property and territory analysis from supported French public-data sources and supplied dated snapshots, with deterministic reporting. Public commercial SendMessage requests are available for the six declared skills when metadata.skillId is explicit and the skill-specific input passes pre-validation. Single-domain Production R1 missions are quoted at 5.00 USDC before execution. Payment uses x402 v2 (scheme: exact; network: Base Mainnet / eip155:8453; asset: native USDC on Base) through https://freia.jlv-labs.cloud/commercial/execute/{paymentId}. No payment occurs merely by requesting a challenge. Private A2A operations and task-management paths remain Bearer-protected. FREIA does not claim an A2A-x402 protocol extension. freia.decision uses the 5-USDC path only when its normalized inputs resolve to one commercial domain; cross-domain Decision requires separate CROSS pricing. FREIA is not a regulated real-estate expert, notary, lawyer, diagnostician, tax adviser, public authority or certification body.

extensions.description: Registry payment discovery metadata for FREIA x402 payments.

freiaBearer.description: Bearer credential for private/non-commercial A2A execution and protected task-management operations. Public commercial SendMessage with an explicit supported skillId can obtain a payment challenge without Bearer.

skills.name: FREIA Document
skills.description: Prudent analysis of supplied text or validated document envelopes. Raw PDF, image, audio and video are not supported. Public single-domain LEGAL execution is commercially available at 5.00 USDC after input pre-validation.
examples: Analyse a supplied DPE or structured dossier envelope.

skills.name: FREIA Market
skills.description: Geo-DVF transaction diagnostics for supported local datasets. The public single-domain VALUE path is commercially available at 5.00 USDC after commune/property-type validation. Authorised structured asking-price listings remain a separate bounded path; portal scraping is not performed.
examples: Analyse Geo-DVF transactions for Roanne, Maison.
Compare supplied authorised structured listings; do not scrape portals.

skills.name: FREIA Cadastre
skills.description: Factual parcel and cadastral synthesis from supplied authorised dated official snapshots. It does not certify boundaries, ownership or constructibility. Public single-domain LAND execution is commercially available at 5.00 USDC after source pre-validation.
examples: Analyse a supplied dated official parcel snapshot for a commune and parcel.

skills.name: FREIA Urbanism
skills.description: Factual PLU/PLUi zoning, prescriptions, servitudes and document-reference synthesis from supplied dated official snapshots. No live IGN/GPU retrieval and no permit or constructibility decision. Public single-domain LAND execution is commercially available at 5.00 USDC after source pre-validation.
examples: Analyse supplied official PLU/PLUi snapshot references and zoning facts.

skills.name: FREIA Regulation
skills.description: Cautious synthesis of supplied dated official Legifrance or Service-Public snapshots. No live PISTE/Legifrance retrieval, legal opinion, certification or administrative decision. Public single-domain LEGAL execution is commercially available at 5.00 USDC after source pre-validation.
examples: Summarise a supplied dated official regulatory source for an acquisition dossier.

skills.name: FREIA Decision
skills.description: Prudent decision synthesis from normalized E1-E5 outputs. It preserves contradictions and never merges asking prices with transaction prices. Public execution is 5.00 USDC only when the normalized evidence resolves to one VALUE, LAND or LEGAL domain; cross-domain Decision requires separate CROSS pricing.
examples: Create a cautious decision dossier from normalized document, market, cadastre, urbanism and regulation outputs.
